haiku.problem: The question quotes the later half of Mark 9:35 ("the servant of all") and asks the baker to supply the earlier wording ("the last of all"). That asks the baker to guess the words of a line, which trivia.md forbids.

The question says "the Son of Man would be killed," which gives away the answer to question 1 ("Kill Him"). Question 1 comes earlier, so a baker who sees this question first can answer question 1 from it. Trivia.md says a later card must not give away an earlier answer.
